heading: From soundcheck
to showtime.
intro: Set up your band’s inputs, give each musician a personal monitor mix and keep your setlist close. BandPilot controls your mixer over the local network.
explore: Four views to get your show ready
viewTitles: A monitor mix for each musician
viewTexts: Start with a blank scene or one you saved. When you confirm a fresh soundcheck with your band, unused inputs and their sends go silent. Preamp gain and phantom power stay as they are.
Assign each musician an output. Under Monitors → Phones, share the QR code for their mix on the local network. Saving the lineup updates the links without changing the audio.
Arrange songs in rehearsal. At the gig, follow the setlist and open the PDF for the current song.
Switch from the essential controls to the Expert mixer to access the faders, sends and processing available on your model.
modelTexts: Six physical Aux outputs for monitor mixes. The XR18 has been detected on hardware. The MR18 profile has been checked in simulation.
Two physical Aux outputs for monitors. The USB recorder is stereo. Multitrack recording on a computer requires a different model.
Partial, experimental support. Basic mixing and bus sends are available. Full scenes and personal phone monitoring are still in development.
androidText: On an Android tablet, the APK controls the mixer without a computer. For a personal monitor on a phone, just scan the QR code shared by your band.
steps: Install BandPilot and open simulation mode to explore the controls.
Connect your computer and mixer to the same local network, then select the detected mixer.
Choose the instruments and check the inputs and monitor outputs before confirming the soundcheck.
dev: With Node.js 22.13 or later, run these commands from the repository root, then open the address printed by Vite.
reaper: On desktop, the REAPER bridge connects rehearsal projects to your repertoire. REAPER is a separate download.
alt: Guided soundcheck with a microphone and setup steps
Musician selection and vocal monitor mix controls
Stage view with the current song and the songs that follow
